definitions.explanation: A marine mammal with flippers, found in cold waters worldwide. Known for their sleek bodies and whiskered faces.

examples.japanese: アザラシ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日向|ひなた}ぼっこ→日向ぼっこ：18018_hinatabokko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The seal is basking in the sun on the rock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水族館|すいぞくかん}→水族館：09220_suizokukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧アザラシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ショー→ショー：10950_shoo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a seal show at the aquarium.

examples.japanese: アザラシ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}している→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。

notes:
KANJI WRITING:
Can also be written as {海豹|あざらし} (sea + leopard), though the katakana form is more common.

CONTRAST:
・アザラシ (seal) - no external ear flaps, move by wriggling on land
・⟦アシカ→アシカ：noentry⟧ (sea lion) - has external ear flaps, can walk on flippers
・⟦オットセイ→オットセイ：noentry⟧ (fur seal) - has external ear flaps, thicker fur

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・⟦{海洋|かいよう}→海洋：00143_kaiyou⟧⟦{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい}→哺乳類：04920_honyuurui⟧ (marine mammal)
・⟦{鰭|ひれ}→鰭：noentry⟧ (flipper)
・⟦{髭|ひげ}→ひげ：01332_hige⟧ (whiskers)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・アザラシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧ (baby seal)
・アザラシ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧ (to protect seals)
・アザラシ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧ (a group of seals)

POPULAR IN JAPAN:
Seals are popular animals at Japanese aquariums and zoos. ⟦ゴマフアザラシ→ゴマフアザラシ：noentry⟧ (spotted seal) is a common species seen in Japanese facilities.
